rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material. It requires each such link to say when to read the file. The file has three Markdown links to such files, and each one states when:

- `[CI example](references/ci.md)` appears in "Use the CI example when adding these steps to an existing workflow…". It applies when adding the CI steps to an existing workflow.
- `[references/distributed-requirements.md](…)` appears in "read … before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`". It applies when drafting a requirement that holds at many sites, and when editing one that contains those directives.
- `[references/syntax-details.md](…)` appears in "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, … or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read …". Both conditions are stated.

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is plain code text, not a link. It also comes with a context: it is where to look for `{fixme}` acknowledgments of deferred gaps. No violation query was listed for this site. I found no link that lacks a stated reading condition, so there is no gap.
